## DECISION LOG (Architect-Approved)

**Decision 1 — FR-COM-03 Schema Collision Resolution:**
FR-COM-03 proposed generating an entirely new database table named `cbcs_clients` to hold onboarded users. However, the core CMF pipeline (defined by FR-CBCS-01 and migration `003_full_schema.sql`) already depends on the `profiles` table as the foreign key target for `daily_journals` and `user_programs`. Creating `cbcs_clients` would break referential integrity across the system. 
**Resolution:** FR-COM-03's Stage 3 Auto-Provisioning and Section 5 Data Model are rewritten to execute an `ALTER TABLE profiles` command, injecting the `telegram_user_id`, `program_id`, `enrollment_code`, and `status` columns directly into the existing root table. Migration file `005_commercial_layer.sql` reflects this.
